item.title: You Are Invited to Kilbourne Run Sports Park Community Day
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Kilbourne Run Sports Park Community Day

Wednesday, July 29 at 1 p.m.  |  4625 Westerville Road, 43231


We are excited to invite you to a community day at Kilbourne Run Sports Park on Wednesday, July 29, from 1-3 p.m., to celebrate the new facility. As part of the community day celebration, there will be free activities, food and giveaways for all ages.

Kilbourne Run Sports Park is Columbus Recreation and Parks Department’s newest sports facility - built in collaboration with the Columbus Crew. The sports park brings new opportunities for play, connection and community right to the neighborhood. 

If you’re planning to attend the ceremony, we ask that you RSVP using the button below. Parking is free and will be available on-site. We can't wait to see you! 

RSVP TO CEREMONY

item.title: Postponed: Kilbourne Run Sports Park Opening Day
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Postponed: Kilbourne Run Sports Park Opening Day

The Kilbourne Run Sports Park opening ceremony scheduled for Saturday, May 16, is being rescheduled.

In the meantime, you’re welcome to stop by for an unofficial preview! Come explore the walking trails, enjoy the playgrounds, and gather with family and friends at one of the shelters.

We can’t wait to cut the ribbon with you and celebrate this new community amenity!

Kilbourne Run Sports Park Opening Day

Saturday, May 16 at 10 a.m.  |  4625 Westerville Road, 43231


We are excited to invite you to the opening ceremony for Champions Stadium at Kilbourne Run Sports Park - Columbus Recreation and Parks Department’s newest sports facility - which was built in collaboration with the Columbus Crew.

Following the ceremony, there will be free community activities on site until 12:30 p.m. If you’re planning to attend the ceremony, we ask that you RSVP using the button below. Parking is free and will be available on-site. We can't wait to see you!
